description:
Brain Power Music | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours of Clear Thinking

When your head feels like it's wading through fog — slow to start, hard to hold a thought — the answer usually isn't more stimulation. It's less.

This slow Indian classical music is designed to clear mental fog and support calm, focused thinking without demanding your attention.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of deep, resonant sarod — long liquid sliding notes over a warm tanpura drone, slow and evenly paced from start to finish.

Perfect for deep work, reading, studying, clearing morning brain fog, writing, problem solving, a quiet reset between meetings, or any task that needs a clear head.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarod — a deep, fretless string instrument with long, liquid, sliding notes
Raga: Ahir Bhairav — a serene morning raga with a fresh, clear-headed character
Style: Slow Indian classical solo
Mood: Grounded, lucid, quietly focused
Atmosphere: Deep and spacious — room to think
Duration: 1.5 hours, uninterrupted

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on before the work starts, volume low. The sarod's slow phrases give your thinking a steady floor — no hooks, no builds, nothing to pull you away.
